# Reset password (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`password`](../../flows/password/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Lets a user who forgot the password request an emailed code and set a new password with it ([password flow](../../flows/password/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

A view (page) folder registered in `views/Views.registry.ts`; it reads data only through feature facades ([cms-admin rules](../../apps/cms-admin/RULES.md)). Two steps on one page; the first never says whether the email has an account (D8). The second asks for a TOTP code too when the account uses TOTP.

## Technologies

React, react-hook-form with Zod.

## Entry points

Route `/reset-password`, page `ResetPasswordPage`.

## Where to change what

Form fields and rules: the schemas in `ResetPasswordPage.tsx`; the calls: `features/auth`.
